title: Metropolis, 1 dollar, Silent Film Classic
descriptionPlain: Description Metropolis is one of the most influential films in the history of cinema. This visionary story of a future city, where technology begins to overshadow humanity, has inspired creators and audiences for decades. The coin captures this distinctive atmosphere by combining the rhythm of geometric architecture, the cool sheen of metal, and the iconic figure of Maria – a character defined by the interplay between the human and the mechanical. Selective gilding subtly highlights her dual nature. The design brings together sculptural precision and a reflection on a world seeking balance between technological progress and human emotion.
